scope: Independent read-only game_reviewer, five fixed Imagegen concepts compared with G-D01 and G-D03; no PixelLab or runtime review
verdict: APPROVE as concept selection package; user acceptance remains open
shared: All five substantially reduce bulky frames/stone portals and hanging props. Matte wood, four tabs, three squad cards and readable labels remain.
C01: Clean lean gate translation: flush hinges, small keyhole, door-seam CTA and slim rails. Dungeon identity rests on a few icons.
C02: Clean inset-key silhouette, but small motifs weaken dungeon identity and dark CTA blends into other wood.
C03: Elegant thin field-note UI and clear CTA; map/stair motifs read closer to generic journal than dungeon UI.
C04: Compact rope/pickaxe/lantern/stair identity; CTA less emphasized and courtyard very empty.
C05: Best balanced hybrid, flush key/hinge details and route/stair marks without heavy borders. A few extra corner straps remain restrained.
